Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.proxy

Class EzPacketRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.proxy.EzPacketRegistry
public final class EzPacketRegistry extends Object
Maps namespaced packet ID strings to their corresponding EzPacket implementation classes. Required by EzSerializer to reconstruct packets from raw bytes without knowing the type ahead of time.

Namespace requirement

Every packet ID must be in "pluginId:action" format (e.g. "ezeconomy:balance.request"). This is enforced at registration time to prevent silent ID collisions when multiple plugins — EzEconomy, EzShops, EzAuction, etc. — share the same proxy messenger.

Use EzPacketNamespace.id(String) to build IDs safely: 


 public static final EzPacketNamespace NS = new EzPacketNamespace("ezeconomy");

 public class BalanceRequestPacket implements EzPacket {
     @Override public String packetId() { return NS.id("balance.request"); }
 }

Thread-safe.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public <T extends EzPacket> EzPacketRegistry register(Class<T> packetClass)
      Register a packet class under its declared EzPacket.packetId().

      The packet ID must be in "pluginId:action" format. The class must also have a public no-arg constructor so EzSerializer can instantiate it via Gson.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the packet type
      Parameters:
      packetClass - the packet implementation class to register
      Returns:
      this registry for fluent chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is not namespaced, or if the class lacks a public no-arg constructor

    • register

      public <T extends EzPacket> EzPacketRegistry register(String id, Class<T> packetClass)
      Register a packet class under an explicit ID, overriding its EzPacket.packetId() value. The explicit ID must still be in "pluginId:action" format.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the packet type
      Parameters:
      id - the namespaced packet ID to register under
      packetClass - the packet implementation class
      Returns:
      this registry for fluent chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is not in "pluginId:action" format
